answer.explanation: The timing registers (hdisplay, hsynclength, vsynclength, etc. in project.v:20-29) are never reset by rst_n — the only assignment path is `always @(posedge ui_in[7])` (project.v:87), which loads the 640×480@60 defaults when ui_in[3:0]=0. Verilator zero-initializes regs, so at power-on all porch/sync-length fields are 0, and hvsync_generator never produces a periodic hsync/vsync (matches result.json: hsync_transitions=1, vsync_transitions=1, no-sync after the full 25,175,000-clock window). This run had override=null, so ui_in[7] was never pulsed. The project's own "How to test" section confirms this: "pulse ui_in[7]" with ui_in[3:0]=0 to load a known-good configuration. This is exactly the wrong-inputs failure mode, and it was already diagnosed and fixed in commit 5203b88 (overrides/tt09/tt_um_rebeccargb_vga_timing_experiments.yaml/.inputs), which this bundle's override.yaml reproduces.
